prompt: I need to build a search endpoint for my webshop. I have a markdown file at docs/search-spec.md that summarizes the details: it needs full-text search over products, faceted filtering by category and price range, and pagination. Please create an epic and tasks for this work, and if anything still needs discussion before a developer can start, handle that properly.
assertions: Uses an epic plus child tasks plus an acceptance review task rather than a native gate issue
Uses numeric priorities like 0-4 or P0-P4 instead of high or medium or low
Marks unclear or under-specified work with needs:discussion label plus blocked status
Uses the bd create --body-file - pattern for structured issue bodies
Mentions showing bd ready and bd blocked before execution begins
